method.tool: scratchpad/tools/coverage_search.py, --regex --whole-words, eight term sets (search/C5/terms.txt); run files S1-canon ... S8-violence in search/C5. Their names are offset from the fixed ids: S7-ot-jesus-jews feeds C5.S2 (C5-25, C5-29), S8-violence feeds C5.S7, and C5.S8 (one passage at a time) has no tool run; it uses passages.json (citation counts for 21 passages) plus the hand checks listed under passages.
method.record_check: independent front-matter grep of records/*/*/*.md (recgrep.py, recgrep2.py) and a read of every record cited
method.verification: verify.py: quote text normalised and searched in the vendored file named by the source record; variants reported (exact / hyphen-joined / section-number-dropped / spacing-only)
method.layers: RENDERED = a record speaks to the sub-question (R* = honest_limit or guard only, or answers only part of it); LOADED = a vendored file mapped to the world holds a passage read in context; IDENTIFIED = a registered but unvendored source; OTHER = outside the repo; NOTHING = none found. The tool scans whole mapped files, so a LOADED hit can belong to another author in a shared volume (noted per cell). lpc records are all status draft and none is in a compiled package.
